description: k-mer Jaccard index |A∩B|/|A∪B| (exact, or Mash bottom-s MinHash estimate with sketchSize > 0), the Mash distance -ln(2J/(1+J))/k (Ondov et al. 2016), the Mash p-value and x/s in sketch mode, and the exact containment indices |A∩B|/|A|, |A∩B|/|B| (Koslicki & Zabeti 2019). scaled = S in 1..4294967295 (requires canonical=true; sourmash DNA hashing is always canonical and skips non-ACGT k-mers) uses sourmash FracMinHash sketches (keep hashes <= max_hash(S); Jaccard, bias-corrected contained_by, max_containment; Irber et al. 2022, Hera et al. 2023); trackAbundance=true adds the sourmash angular_similarity of the abundance vectors. canonical=true gives Mash/sourmash k-mers.

canonical.description: Canonical k-mers min(w, revcomp(w)), non-ACGT windows skipped (mash dist default, sourmash, jellyfish -C)

acgtOnly.description: Skip k-mers containing a non-ACGT symbol (mash sketch -n)

sketchSize.description: 0 = exact sets (default); s > 0 = Mash MinHash sketch size (mash -s; Mash default 1000), MurmurHash3_x64_128 seed 42, k <= 32

scaled.description: 0 = no FracMinHash (default); S in 1..4294967295 = sourmash scaled factor (MinHash(n=0, scaled=S); sourmash ScaledType is u32), canonical k-mers (requires canonical=true), non-ACGT k-mers skipped (add_sequence force=True), MurmurHash3_x64_128 seed 42, hashes <= (u64::MAX as f64 / S) as u64 kept; sourmash default 1000; 1 = exact. Mutually exclusive with sketchSize

trackAbundance.description: With scaled > 0: track k-mer abundances (sourmash track_abundance=True) and return angularSimilarity (sourmash angular_similarity = 1 - 2*acos(cos)/pi of the abundance vectors) and weightedContainmentSeq1InSeq2/weightedContainmentSeq2InSeq1 (sourmash contained_by_weighted)

jaccard.description: Jaccard index in [0,1]; 0 when both k-mer sets are empty

mashDistance.description: Mash distance in [0,1] (0 for identical sets, 1 when no k-mer is shared, capped at 1)

containmentSeq1InSeq2.description: Exact containment |A∩B|/|A| (0 when A is empty); with scaled > 0 sourmash A.contained_by(B) (bias-corrected)

containmentSeq2InSeq1.description: Exact containment |A∩B|/|B| (0 when B is empty); with scaled > 0 sourmash B.contained_by(A)

sharedHashes.description: Sketch mode: shared hashes x of Mash's x/s; scaled mode: |A∩B| (sourmash count_common); null in exact mode

sketchDenominator.description: Sketch mode: union hashes compared (denominator of x/s); scaled mode: |A∪B|; null in exact mode

pValue.description: Sketch mode: Mash p-value P(X >= x), X ~ Binomial(denominator, r); null in exact mode

maxContainment.description: Scaled mode: sourmash max_containment (shared / min(|A|,|B|), bias-corrected); null otherwise

angularSimilarity.description: trackAbundance: sourmash angular_similarity of the two abundance-weighted FracMinHash sketches; null otherwise

weightedContainmentSeq1InSeq2.description: trackAbundance: sourmash contained_by_weighted of seq1 in seq2 (sum of seq1 abundances over shared hashes / sum of all seq1 abundances); null otherwise

weightedContainmentSeq2InSeq1.description: trackAbundance: sourmash contained_by_weighted of seq2 in seq1; null otherwise

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
sketchSize and scaled are mutually exclusive (Mash bottom-s vs sourmash FracMinHash)
scaled > 0 requires canonical=true (sourmash DNA FracMinHash hashes canonical k-mers only)
